item.title: Version 0.1.20
item.description:
RunBar 0.1.20 — fix Save & reconnect doing nothing.
The Settings → Strava → Manage sheet has a primary button labelled "Save & reconnect", but it was only persisting the new credentials and dismissing the sheet — no OAuth round-trip, no Strava authorize page in the browser. So if you tried to switch to a different Strava account (or fix a stale token) from Settings, youd save your client_id/secret and then sit there wondering why the connection never actually re-established.
The sheet now mirrors what the onboarding flow already did: save → kick off OAuth (opens the Strava authorize URL in your default browser) → on success, seed 8 weeks of derived weekly snapshots so the goal seed and the popover sparkline reflect reality immediately.
